title: Политика входящих HTTP cookies для binding plugin Liapoldus v1
description: Gateway/Caddy-owned policy. One policy applies to exactly one plugin instance and one capability; it is not sent to the plugin.

x-liapoldus-semantics.nameComparison: case-sensitive exact match; wildcards and regular expressions are not supported
x-liapoldus-semantics.forwarding: Before Call or Stream dispatch, forward only allow-listed request cookies for the selected plugin instance and capability. Omit every other cookie.
x-liapoldus-semantics.duplicates: Preserve the order and multiplicity of matching request cookie pairs; plugin code owns interpretation of repeated names.
x-liapoldus-semantics.empty: An empty allowedNames list forwards no cookies.
x-liapoldus-semantics.policyTransport: This Gateway policy is local configuration and is never included in the plugin payload.
x-liapoldus-semantics.redaction: Cookie values are credentials: redact them from logs, traces, audit records, diagnostics, and error messages.
